Receipt totals include valid dated payments on ANY trip in the period. Undated collections are reported separately across ALL owner trips. Cancelled trips are included.

post.description: XLSX only; 2 MiB compressed, 20 MiB expanded, 500 trip rows. Persists original bytes and review metadata. Reuploading identical bytes returns the same owner-scoped import.

post.description: Each row commits independently. HTTP 200 can contain pending row-level conflicts. Review results. Retries match persisted import + sheet + row mappings. Different resolution for committed row conflicts. No automatic customer creation or payment inference.

TripInput.description: endAt must be after startAt. Currency is INR; timestamps require offsets. Unknown fields including calculated totals are rejected.

TripPatch.description: changeReason is required. Charge cannot fall below valid collections. Booking changes use atomic reservations. A concurrent modification returns 409.

rows.reviewNote: Separate advance and remaining receipt confirmed. Payment dates and methods remain unknown. Vehicle, dates and billing confirmed.
